newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-NIGERIAN GOALKEEPER CRITICALLY HURT IN CAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIAN GOALKEEPER CRITICALLY HURT IN CAR CRASH.

text.p: Nigerian goalkeeper Joseph Dosu, who won an Olympic gold medal last year, was critically injured when a car he was driving crashed on a Lagos road, sports officials said on Monday.
"We understand arrangements are being made to fly him abroad following a serious motor accident," an official of the Nigerian football association said.
Local newspapers said Dosu sustained spinal injuries when the car somersaulted several times as he was driving along a major Lagos road at dawn on Sunday.

Dosu plays for Italian side Reggiana, who have just been relegated from serie A. He was in Lagos for a World Cup African zone match against Kenya which Nigeria won 3-0 on Saturday to become the first team to qualify for next year's finals in France.
Dosu, who was in goal when Nigeria beat Argentina in the Olympic final in the United States last year, was the reserve goalkeeper in Saturday's match.
